title.en: Numerical computation, conditioning, and reliable experiments
title.zh: 数值计算、条件数与可靠实验

lead.en: Separate representation, sensitivity and algorithmic error; choose suitable solves, stable probability losses and scale-aware derivative checks.
lead.zh: 区分表示、敏感性与算法误差，选择合适求解器、稳定概率损失及尺度导数检查。

prerequisites.en: Modules 14, 18 and 19; all three labs use the pinned NumPy environment. SciPy is an optional reading comparison, not a lab dependency.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 14、18、19，三实验均用固定 NumPy 环境。SciPy 只作选学阅读比较，不是实验依赖。

en: Explain local spacing, rounding, overflow and underflow by dtype.
Analyse absolute/relative error, cancellation, summation and comparisons.
Derive linear perturbation bounds and distinguish residual from forward accuracy.
Choose square, QR/SVD and iterative solves with rank and cost stated.
Implement stable logit losses and independent smooth derivative sweeps.
Report precision, approximation sources, versions and justified tolerances.
zh: 按 dtype 解释间距、舍入、上溢及下溢。
分析绝对相对误差、消去、求和及比较。
推线性扰动界，区分残差与前向准确性。
按秩和成本选择方形、QR/SVD 或迭代求解。
实施稳定 logit 损失及独立平滑导数扫描。
报告精度、近似来源、版本及有依据容差。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and distinguish rounding, cancellation and tolerances.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，区分舍入、消去及容差。
查看 finfo 及正规次正规约定。

text.en: Retrieve input, accumulation and output precision.
text.zh: 检索输入、累加和输出精度。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and prove perturbation and Gram identities.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，证扰动与 Gram 恒等式。

text.en: Measure precision loss and repair a cancelling expression.
text.zh: 测精度丢失并修复消去式。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and derive stable losses and derivative checks.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，推稳定损失与导数检查。
比较求解器、残差及敏感性。

text.en: Repair overflow and audit derivative step sizes.
text.zh: 修复上溢并核查差分步长。

text.en: Complete choices and write a numerical audit.
text.zh: 完成选择并写数值核查。

text.en: Inspect solver thresholds and stable probability references.
text.zh: 查看求解阈值及稳定概率参考。

text.en: Complete the exit task and justify error evidence.
text.zh: 完成结业并说明误差证据依据。
